param: Λ Recruitment/birth rate (all newborns enter Susceptible). Value not provided.
μ Natural death rate (assumed equal to birth rate in non-dimensionalization; total population constant). Value not provided.
ν Vaccination rate (Susceptible to Vaccinated). Value not provided.
δ Vaccine waning rate (Vaccinated to Susceptible). Value not provided.
β Effective transmission/contact rate causing infection. Value not provided.
ρ Reinfection coefficient/parameter (drives backward bifurcation; does not explicitly appear in R0 per paper text). Value not provided.
γ Recovery rate (Infected to Recovered). Value not provided.
ω Temporary immunity waning rate (Recovered to Susceptible). Value not provided.
